verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents automatic categorization of imported transactions, claiming up to 98% auto-categorization including with connected Brex feeds, plus an on-demand "ask AI" categorization button, custom categorization rules and batch categorization. Nothing in the evidence shows the system learning from a user's corrections; custom rules are a manual substitute rather than adaptive learning. Missing for 10: evidence that suggestions adapt to user corrections, detailed docs on how auto-categorization works, independent or hands-on corroboration of categorization accuracy.
